summary: PBF Energy Inc. and PBF Holding Company LLC filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting that on September 30, 2026 PBF Holding, with certain wholly-owned subsidiaries as borrowers or guarantors, entered into an amended and restated asset-based revolving credit agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent and other lenders. The 2026 Revolving Loan replaces the August 23, 2023 credit agreement, carries a $4.0 billion maximum commitment, reduced unused commitment fees, and matures September 30, 2031, with interest and letter-of-credit fees generally consistent with the prior facility. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation.
